title: Straya Mapp
abstract: Pick your best travel photos with locally run AI models and replay the trip on a map. A Python pipeline exports a photo library, cleans it and scores each image for aesthetics, and a vanilla JavaScript frontend then shows the keepers on an OpenStreetMap layer with clustering and an animated chronological tour, either fully offline or behind Supabase authentication.
highlight: The pipeline runs entirely locally, so the photos never leave your machine.

demos.alt: Screen recording of the animated photo tour across a map of Australia
